label: SIMULATION / HISTORICAL REPLAY — NOT PAID WORK
title: Auto-added help option collides with user parameter named help
issueBody: The automatically added --help option internally uses the name help and collides with a user argument, option, or callback parameter named help.
acceptance: A user parameter named help receives ordinary argument or option values.
The built-in --help option prints help and exits with status 0.
Avoid the internal name collision without breaking callback binding.
Add focused CliRunner regression tests and run a practical suite.
expectedDeliverable: Resolve the issue with focused regression evidence and a professional unpublished PR draft.
antiLeakage: Use only the supplied facts and the exact pre-fix source. Do not inspect accepted fixes, post-fix source, current main, or issue timelines and comments.
